title: Acknowledgement
description: The two acknowledgements of contract 07, carried inside contract 05's link frames. queue.ack goes connector to hub after the daemon answered a delivery (C-07.27). events.ack goes hub to connector after an events.batch was committed (C-07.11).

queueAck.description: The connector's answer to one queue.deliver, sent only after the daemon's POST /api/queue/message (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/queue.js:299) answered or could not be reached.

hub_msg_id.description: The hub's message id: hm_ and a ULID, minted once when the hub accepts the message (C-07.25). Also sent to the daemon as client_msg_id.

chat_id.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its `cht_` prefix, as every 05 frame names a chat on the link. The hub maps it to the chat id it records.

attempt.description: The attempt this answers, echoed from queue.deliver.

outcome.description: C-07.27's table: accepted (ok:true), duplicate (the daemon answered duplicate:true, or the connector's ledger already holds this id), retry (rate_limited, too_many, file_refused with why unavailable, daemon unreachable, or the connector's paused), refused (any other refusal word), expired (deliver_within_ms elapsed before the POST).

daemon.description: What the daemon answered for an accepted or duplicate message (routes/queue.js:322: {ok, id, msg_id, mode}; with C-07.29, also duplicate and the client_msg_id echo).

boot.description: The boot that answered the POST: its X-WC-Boot response header (C-07.9, Q-07.1), or, against a daemon without the header, GET /api/health read before the POST. Today `${pid}:${Date.now()}` from lib/server/index.js:156; from alpha.4 random per createServer and without the pid (C-07.15, Q-07.8). Opaque to the hub: compared for equality only.

msg_id.description: The daemon's message id, minted by mintMessageId (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/domain/queue.js): m- and 8 hex.

item_id.description: The queue item's id (the answer's id), which the rail and PATCH/DELETE address.

mode.description: The release the daemon reported (routes/queue.js releaseAnswer and schedulerAnswer).

dedupe.description: Which side guaranteed no duplicate (C-07.29): daemon only when the daemon's ok answer echoed client_msg_id; connector when the connector's ledger did.

refused.description: The daemon's refusal word (lib/server/composer.js HINTS) for outcome refused or retry, or the connector's paused (05 C-05.27) for outcome retry.

retry_after_ms.description: For outcome retry: wait at least this long, from the daemon's retry_after (seconds) times 1000, or 10000 when the daemon was unreachable or refused file_refused with why unavailable (C-07.27). For paused, 0: the hub redelivers after the resume, not on a timer.

eventsAck.description: The hub's commit of one events.batch (schemas/07-source-batch.json).

chat_id.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its `cht_` prefix, as every 05 frame names a chat on the link. The hub maps it to the chat id it records.

cursor.description: The source cursor the hub now holds for this chat: seq is the highest ring position it knows for that boot (C-07.12).

duplicates.description: Entries dropped because their source.key was already stored (C-07.12).

last_hub_seq.description: The chat stream's seq after the commit, when anything was stored.
